title: A Terminal for the Colony
author: Mirabel Marchetti
blurb: Juniper Okonkwo, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
